title: Burgers, caprese or avocado-bacon

items: 1 slice fresh mozzarella (about 1 oz), ¼ inch thick
1 slice ripe tomato, ¼ inch thick
3 fresh basil leaves or 1 Tbsp pesto

steps: Cook the bacon in the skillet over medium heat 8–12 min, turning a few times, until crisp. Drain on a paper-towel-lined plate. Pour off all but about 1 Tbsp of the fat.

Divide the beef into 4 equal portions (6 oz each). Gently shape each into a patty ¾ inch thick and about ½ inch wider than the buns. Press a shallow thumbprint into the center so they don't puff up. Season both sides with the salt and pepper right before cooking.
Spread the butter on the cut sides of the buns. Toast them cut side down in the skillet over medium heat 1–2 min, until golden. Set aside.
Raise the heat to medium-high. Add the patties and cook 4–5 min without pressing them, until a brown crust forms. Flip.
Cook 3–4 min more. For the last minute, lay cheddar on 3 patties and the mozzarella on 1, then cover with the lid until the cheese melts. The burgers are done at 160°F in the center.
Build the caprese burger with the mozzarella patty, tomato, basil or pesto and a drizzle of balsamic glaze. Build the others with the cheddar patties, 2 slices bacon each and the avocado.
tips: Grill: heat to medium-high (about 400–450°F) and oil the grates. Cook 4–5 min per side, until 160°F.
Don't press the patties with the spatula. It squeezes out the juice and makes dry burgers.
Want ⅓-lb burgers instead: use 1⅓ lb beef for 4 patties, or make 5 from 1⅔ lb.
storage: Cooked patties keep 3–4 days in the fridge. Reheat in a covered skillet over medium-low heat 4–5 min, until hot (165°F). Store toppings separately and build the burgers fresh.
